# Pranay Suyash

> Product leader and hands-on systems builder for AI, workflow, internal tools, local-first products, and spatial systems.

Canonical site: https://pranaysuyash.com
Last evidence review: 2026-07-16

## Professional identity

- Core value: keeps product judgment, operating context, interface decisions, architecture, and enough implementation skill close enough to produce useful systems.
- Working style: asks for real artefacts and constraints early; moves between commercial goal, workflow, interface, architecture, and code; separates fact, inference, and unresolved risk; takes delivery through error states, documentation, release gates, and handoff.
- Current context: Co-Founder / Head of Product & Platforms at MedPiper (YC S20), Bengaluru, India.

## Work modes

- Senior internal role: sustained ownership across product direction, platform choices, cross-functional execution, and what the organisation learns after launch.
- Bounded commercial engagement: a defined workflow, system, subsystem, correction, or decision with explicit scope, delivery evidence, and an end condition.
- Commercial contracting: separate project and advisory terms may be handled through PSRS Technologies Private Limited where applicable; the personal site remains the identity and proof-of-work surface.

## Audited product case studies

- SignKit: https://pranaysuyash.com/work/sig-ext-fastapi
  - Maturity: commercial product
  - Boundary: local signature-image extraction, cleanup, and PDF placement; not certified e-signature verification
- MetaExtract: https://pranaysuyash.com/work/metaextract
  - Maturity: working product build
  - Boundary: metadata coverage, provenance, review and export; field count is not verified correctness
- SentinelTwin: https://pranaysuyash.com/work/sentineltwin
  - Maturity: active platform build
  - Boundary: deterministic coverage and path reasoning before AI explanation
- EchoPanel: https://pranaysuyash.com/work/echopanel
  - Maturity: working prototype
  - Boundary: local capture, transcription and retrieval direction; system-audio setup and production packaging remain active work

## Evidence rules

- Production, commercial, active-build, and prototype states are not interchangeable.
- Workflow diagrams are labelled as diagrams, not product screenshots.
- Source, tests, runbooks, architecture records, and independent public records are linked where available.
- Testimonials, customer counts, adoption metrics, and certification claims are omitted without permissioned evidence.
- The interactive systems lab is illustrative progressive enhancement; standard HTML case studies are the source of truth.
